execute.description: create new table "_prisma_new_artifact" with desired schema
execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "_prisma_new_artifact" (
  "authorAgentId" TEXT,
  "basename" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "byteSize" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')) NOT NULL,
  "digest" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "pieceId" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "supersededByArtifactId" TEXT,
  "title" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  UNIQUE ("supersededByArtifactId"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("supersededByArtifactId") REFERENCES "artifact" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
)

postcheck.description: verify foreign key (pieceId) → piece(id) is gone from "artifact"
postcheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS "result" FROM pragma_foreign_key_list('artifact') WHERE "table" = 'piece'
